method.parse: Each journal line matching /^(\S+) \S+ [^:]+: \[embed-backfill\] (.*)$/ is bucketed by timestamp into pre-window or window. 'sweep complete: tab=e/s ...' and 'sweep embedded NOTHING (scanned=N errors=N) — tab=e/s(errN) ...' lines give per-target embedded/scanned counts.
method.errorClass: A message is error-like when it matches /(fail|error|err\d|NOTHING|timed? ?out|refus|reject|abort|skipp|expired|exception|cannot|could not|unavailable|invalid|denied|crash|killed)/i and is not a 'sweep complete' line.
method.normalization: uuids -> <uuid>, hex runs of 10+ -> <hex>, every number -> #, then truncated to 240 chars. A window message is 'new' when its normalized form never occurs pre-window.

attribution.inference: The new messages are environment faults (embedding sidecar unavailable, database stall) that the pre-extraction engine would have logged the same way. This is an inference from the timing and the unchanged message sources; it does not change the verdict, because the bar does not exempt environment faults.
attribution.followUp: The falsifier cannot tell an environment fault from a regression. Any change to its wording is a rubric revision that needs rubric-vetting with the post-evidence timing disclosed (tracked on EI-24823955272728864); it must not be applied silently to turn this result into a pass.
